messages:
Maya: Morning all — quick share: balcony battlestation + grow light + a cat who thinks ethernet is a toy. picture: https://i.imgur.com/FeaQhGk.jpg :seedling: :cat2:
Sam: lol Ramen already claimed the PoE injector :joy:
Chris: did your ISP drop or just local flakiness?
Maya: ISP outage around 10:02. Had to tether my phone and USB-bridge it to the router. Ugly but worked. Example I ran on mac: `sudo ifconfig en5 down; sudo ifconfig en5 up`
Amelia: pro tip — run `ping -c 5 1.1.1.1` to confirm path. also congrats on ergonomic ficus setup :thumbsup:
NetMonBot: automated: Detected increased mobile-tether traffic from Maya's IP (10.0.x.x). Not an incident for infra, just FYI.
Sam: if you want, I have a spare 10m cable and a clamp — free delivery via porch drop. @Maya?
Maya: thanks @Sam! last time the cat chewed through the cable, so now it's duct-taped to a flower stake :joy_cat:
Chris: quick poll — what's your WFH outage workaround? React with 🅰️ hotspot 🅱️ neighbor tether 🆎 co-working 🟩 I never lose internet
Amelia: 🅰️ for me. Phone plan's my hero.
Maya: 🅰️ too. Also considering a small 4G router for future apocalypse.
Sam: 🆎 co-working once when my power went out — weirdly productive.
Chris: @Maya drop me a time and I can swing by with a new cable tomorrow evening, unless Ramen intercepts again :cat_with_tears_of_joy:
Maya: perfect — 7pm works. I'll set porch drop. thanks all :heart:
